decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe has shown early evidence of value in a growing market, and it builds on existing tube competence at low holding cost, so the option merits further commitment.
The single-U probe is a low-cost extension of the established geothermal line, and demand for heat pumps and geothermal systems is still rising, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
The probe surface technology is uncertain but complements the geothermal portfolio and costs little to maintain, so it is premature to abandon it without negative evidence.
Fire-protection steel profiles sit close to the core building-systems business and face steady regulatory demand, so the cost of keeping them is minimal relative to their potential.
The slim steel profile system fits the firm's established facade and window offering and shares its production and sales channels, so the holding cost is low and the option stays open.
The decorative surface system is a niche variant with uncertain demand, but its incremental cost on existing profile lines is low, so the firm keeps it pending clearer results.
